column2: Tourism Receipts By Major Components (Year-To-Date), Quarterly

column4: Sightseeing, Entertainment & Gaming (SEG) includes entrance fees to attractions and nightspots, expenditure on day-tours, leisure events as well as entertainment at the Integrated Resorts.
Other TR components include expenditure on airfares on Singapore-based carriers, port taxes, local transportation, business, medical, education, transit visitors and COVID-19 related costs.
